subject: Create a record table with camtrapR from agouti files

messages.author: cd5f85fa70152c58
messages.subject: Create a record table with camtrapR from agouti files
parts:
Hi, I am a beginner and try to learn to use camtrapR. I exported data from camera traps on Agouti (I have 3 files, deploymentData, observationData, Mediadata). I want to make analyses using camtrapR. I merged my deploymentData and observationData to create a unique table. Now I try to create a "record table" but it looks like I need to create directories and store raw images inside. I don't have the raw images from agouti, the mediadata is a simple table containing the url of each image. 
I would need some advices to start analyses as I am a bit lost now! 
My merged table contains all the basic informations from camera traps: deploymentID, deploymentStart, deploymentEnd, eventID, eventStart, eventEnd, species identified, count of individuals per observation, station name, observationID, observationTime, cameraID... 
I would appreciate some help. Thanks!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Create a record table with camtrapR from agouti files
parts:
Hello,
you don't need the images, instead you can simply use the record table (observationData) as a basis for further analyses, such as activity or occupancy. It contains all the relevant information (location, date/time, species). If necessary you can filter the record table to only contain independent records using filterRecordTable().
If you can be more specific about the type of analysis you wish to conduct and the attempts you made then it would be easier to provide guidance.
Best regards,
